name: Hell n' Slash
description:
About This Game

Descend. Die. Descend again.

You are the Hunter: black armor, tattered cloak, a sword too big for any man and a crossbow strapped to your arm. Beyond the portal await 100 chambers of stone, bone and embers, and a god who has watched you die a thousand times and still finds it funny.

Combat with real weight

Every strike has wind-up, contact and consequence. Hitstop, camera shake, sparks, debris and blood answer every cut. Chain sword combos, fire crossbow bolts mid-fight, drag enemies in with the iron hook and dodge at the very last moment.



  • Colossal sword: light and heavy combos, air strikes and lunges that actually slice creatures apart.
  • Arm-mounted crossbow: iron bolts that hit from range without ever letting go of the sword.
  • Chain grappling hook: drag enemies to you or launch yourself to the nearest wall.
  • Fury: fill the gauge in the middle of the carnage and wake the berserker inside the Hunter.

A descent that never repeats

Four regions, each with its own architecture, monsters and horror: the Ash Crypts, the Forges of Exile, the Halls of Oaths and, at last, the Threshold.
  • 100 chambers paced like a Hades run: fight, breather, reward, boss.
  • 5 challenges per chamber: Ambush, The Hunt, Cursed Floor, Darkness and Survival.
  • Elites with affixes: Volatile, Frenzied, Blazing, Summoner, Stoneborn.
  • Traps that hurt the hero and the monsters alike. Turn the arena against them.
  • Four bosses with three phases each: Hellcreeper, Perderos, Laminoferox and the Tyranopode.

Pacts sealed in wax

Along the descent, ancient powers offer you pacts. Each one is a wax seal that changes the way you fight, and they combine in ways not even the Maker foresaw. Between descents, the Sanctum keeps the Essence you brought back and turns every defeat into strength for the next attempt.

The Hall of Ashes

Between descents you return to the Hall, a ruined cathedral home to five residents, each with their own story, keepsakes and favors. On the throne, bored, sits the Maker: the god who invented this place, narrates your run with sarcasm and has no problem talking to you, the player, on the other side of the screen.



Heavy metal from start to finish

A heavy metal soundtrack drives every fight and swells with the combat. Stylized gore, grim low-poly environments and dramatic lighting complete the mood.

Highlights

  • Isometric hack'n'slash with the feel of Hades, Devil May Cry and God of War.
  • Roguelike with permanent progression in the Sanctum.
  • A narrator who breaks the fourth wall.
  • Fully playable with a controller or mouse and keyboard.
  • Interface and subtitles in English and Brazilian Portuguese. The game will receive interface and subtitle localization into 13 more languages.
short_desc: A brutal dark fantasy hack'n'slash roguelike. Carve through 100 cursed chambers with a colossal sword, an arm-mounted crossbow and an iron grappling hook. Seal pacts in wax and blood, and outlast the bored god who narrates every single one of your deaths.
